notes.title: English is available now (2/4 Update)
notes.content:
In our most recent update:

-The English version of game is available
-New UI system
-bug fixed
-New ending 
[spoiler] Cmplete this ending by choose option that's suspect Mr. Rabbit in the conversation with Viktor before the final mission, then the extra mission will be active [/spoiler]
